context: An elderly couple swaps light teasing on a sunny morning
purpose: Teach: 当てはまる/数少ない/ほほ/判り/爽やか/気持ちよく/くだらない/けっして

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今朝はずいぶん爽やかな風が入ってくるねえ。庭の梅も気持ちよく揺れているよ。
lines.en: What a refreshing breeze this morning. Even the plum tree in the garden is swaying pleasantly.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried, slightly raspy elderly male voice with gentle morning cheer.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: あなた、また窓を全部開けて。風邪をひいてもけっして私のせいにしないでくださいね。
lines.en: Dear, you've opened every window again. Don't you dare blame me if you catch a cold.
lines.style: Affectionate scolding tone, soft grandmotherly cadence with a teasing smile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ははは、お前はいつも心配性だ。そのほほを膨らませた顔、五十年前と変わらないなあ。
lines.en: Haha, you always worry too much. That pouting face hasn't changed in fifty years.
lines.style: Playful chuckle, fond reminiscing tone with a teasing lilt.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: もう、朝からくだらないお世辞はやめてください。判りやすい嘘ですよ、本当に。
lines.en: Oh stop it, no flattery first thing in the morning. It's such an obvious lie, really.
lines.style: Mock-exasperated, light laugh hidden under the words, warm familiarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 嘘じゃないさ。私の数少ない自慢のひとつだよ、こんな美人と暮らせていることは。
lines.en: It's not a lie. Living with such a beauty is one of my few sources of pride.
lines.style: Soft sincere delivery turning into gentle teasing, low warm chuckle at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: まあ、その台詞が当てはまる相手は本当に私だけかしら。怪しいものですよ。
lines.en: My, I wonder if I'm really the only one that line applies to. Quite suspicious.
lines.style: Coy raised-eyebrow tease, playful suspicion with affectionate undertone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おいおい、こんな朝から疑うのかい。さあ、お茶でも淹れてくれよ、女房殿。
lines.en: Now now, suspecting me this early in the day? Come, brew some tea for me, dear wife.
lines.style: Mock-wounded then jovial, hearty old-man warmth with a soft laugh.
